## Required Checks

- [ ] I kept proposal, method behavior, project evidence, and outside context distinct.
- [ ] I did not change a locked rule or frozen preregistration post hoc.
- [ ] I did not treat model agreement, a citation, or predicted structure as evidence.
- [ ] Therapeutic language, if any, addresses causal entity, direction, cell/state, modality, and delivery.
- [ ] Synthetic data, if any, are seeded/labeled/segregated and make no MS claim.
- [ ] Negatives and inconclusive outcomes are reported, not hidden.
- [ ] Local tests and `git diff --check` pass.
- [ ] No tracked file exceeds 50 MB or lives under `tmp/`; no weight/cache is added.
- [ ] I made no patient-specific recommendation or medical-advice claim.
- [ ] I did not silently upgrade any finding, lead, evidence grade, or validation status.
